params.body:
Two things Shane found on staging in the "Relatie selecteren" picker.

## The search survived the close

Type "frederik", pick nobody, close, open again: the word and its filtered list were still
there. The picker is an iframe the page loads once and the modal only shows and hides, so the
Livewire component inside stays alive between two openings — including when the next opening
comes from another screen (the vehicle sheet, the offer, order and rental modals all share one
`#relationModal`).

Cleared on **open**, not on close. A close also happens in ways this page never sees (escape,
the backdrop, another script calling `.modal('hide')`); an open always precedes use, so it is
the only moment guaranteed to run before someone reads the list. The event is
`shown.bs.modal`, because the own modal layer that replaced Bootstrap's plugin
(`resources/js/modal.js`) fires only `shown`/`hidden`.

Everything the previous visit chose is reset, not just the input: the sort choice and how far
"load more" had grown decide what the list shows just as much as the search term does, and a
list that looks complete while it is not is worse than an empty one. The iframe is scrolled
back to the top as well. `Relations::resetPicker()` listens for `relation-picker-reset`.

## It was not usable on a phone

At 390px the wide table was squeezed into the modal: the generic `.ui-list` card collapse puts
every cell as "Column  value" right aligned, which gave three right-aligned values stacked with
the Selecteren button loose underneath.

Same card pattern, but left aligned and with a hierarchy: the display name as the heading
(`DealerRelation::getDisplayNameAttribute()`, so a nameless relation still reads as something),
e-mail and phone as the quiet lines under it, and Selecteren full width with a 44px target. A
relation named after its own e-mail address does not repeat that address on the line below.
One block in `refresh.css`, entirely inside `@media (max-width: 767px)` and scoped to
`.ui-picker`: the desktop table and the relation overview outside the modal are untouched, and
so is what picking a relation does.

## Rules and findings

- R P2-5.9 (the picker opens clean) and R P2-5.10 (its narrow-screen shape) in
  `docs/bedrijfsregels/32-p2-mijn-garage.md`, referenced from R S4-4.14.
- X-124 and X-125 in `docs/bedrijfsregels/90-x-bevindingen.md`.

## Tests

`tests/Feature/RelationPickerTest.php`, seven tests: the page the iframe loads carries no
search term, a fresh component holds none either, the reset clears search, sort and paging,
the list is the unfiltered one again afterwards, a row leads with the display name, a nameless
relation still has a heading, and the overview outside the modal keeps its table.

`php artisan test --filter='Relation|Relatie|Order|Offer|StockList|StylesheetSyntax|AlpineExpression|RulesCoverage'`
— 130 tests, 1023 assertions, green.
params.title: The relation picker kept its search and did not fit a phone
